title: Rebuild full Comment Generator app UI/flows to match uploaded screenshots (Customer View + Upload Section + Admin Panel)

requirements.text: Rebuild the app’s information architecture and navigation to match the uploaded screenshots, including a top-level segmented navigation with three sections: “Customer View”, “Upload Section”, and “Admin Panel”, and ensure the currently selected section is visually highlighted as in the screenshots.
acceptanceCriteria: The main navigation shows three primary sections: Customer View, Upload Section, Admin Panel.
Switching sections updates the content area without full page reload.
Active/selected section is visually distinct (pill/segmented control style) and matches the screenshot layout closely on mobile widths.

requirements.text: Implement the “Customer View” screen to match the screenshots: include a “Single Comment Generator” card and a “Bulk Comment Generator” card, each requiring the user to select a “Comment List” before generating output, with mobile-first spacing, rounded cards, and gradient call-to-action buttons similar to the screenshots.
acceptanceCriteria: Customer View shows a prominent heading and subtitle matching the screenshot’s structure (English text).
Single Comment Generator: user must select a comment list; clicking generate returns one comment and marks it as used for that user/device identity (see backend requirements).
Bulk Comment Generator: user must select a comment list and enter number of comments; clicking generate returns that many available comments (or as many as available) and marks them used.
UI components (cards, inputs, buttons) visually follow the screenshot style: rounded containers, soft shadows, and a blue→teal gradient primary button.

requirements.text: Implement the “Upload Section” screen to match the screenshot: “Upload Rating Image” card with fields for “Your Name” (text input) and “Select Image” (file picker) and an upload action that persists the uploaded image and metadata to the backend for later admin review.
acceptanceCriteria: Upload Section contains an “Upload Rating Image” card with the two inputs (name + file) and an upload button/action.
Selecting an image and submitting uploads the image blob to the backend and stores the uploader name + timestamp.
After successful upload, the UI shows a success confirmation and clears the form (or resets to initial state).
All user-facing text is English.

requirements.text: Implement the “Admin Panel” screen layout to match the screenshots, including an Admin Panel header/subtitle and secondary tab navigation: “Comments”, “Images”, “Chat”, and “Settings”. Admin Panel access must remain gated by the existing URL-hash admin token mechanism (caffeineAdminToken) already implemented in the project.

quotes: redeploy the admin panel section in the website

acceptanceCriteria: Admin Panel route/content is inaccessible without a valid caffeineAdminToken; a clear access denied message is shown otherwise.
Admin Panel shows secondary tabs: Comments, Images, Chat, Settings, with the active tab highlighted similar to the screenshots.
Tab switching changes the visible admin content without leaving the Admin Panel section.
No edits are made to immutable auth hook files; admin gating composes existing logic.

requirements.text: Admin Panel → Comments tab: implement comment list management to match screenshots, including: (1) Create New List (list name input + “Create List” button), (2) Existing Lists selector/list with lock icons, (3) a “Managing: <ListName>” section with available/used counts, reset and delete controls, (4) comment add modes: “Bulk Upload” (textarea: one comment per line) and “Single Comment” (single input), (5) list of comments with per-comment delete actions, and (6) a “Bulk Comment Totals” summary card showing counts per list.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can create a new list by name; the list appears under Existing Lists immediately after creation.
Admin can select a list to manage and sees a “Managing: <ListName>” header.
Admin can add comments in bulk via textarea (one per line) and via a single-comment input; successful add updates counts and comment list.
Admin can delete individual comments and delete an entire list.
Admin can reset usage (used/available counts) for the selected list (behavior defined in backend).
Admin sees a totals/summary area showing total comments per list (and/or available/used) similar to screenshot structure.
UI closely matches screenshot layout, including pill buttons for bulk/single mode and rounded cards.

requirements.text: Admin Panel → Settings tab: implement “Bulk Generator Access Key” management as shown in the screenshots, including display of current status (“Key Set”/“Not Set”), a masked key display, a “Reset Key” action, an input to set a new access key with show/hide toggle, and an “Update Key” button. The Bulk Comment Generator on Customer View must require this access key before allowing bulk generation.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can set/update an access key; backend persists it across reloads/upgrades.
Admin can reset/remove the key.
UI shows masked key when set and an explicit status indicator (set/not set).
Customer Bulk Comment Generator prompts for the access key when required and blocks generation when missing/incorrect.
Access key validation occurs against backend-stored value (not hardcoded in frontend).

requirements.text: Admin Panel → Images tab: provide an admin view of uploaded rating images, including a list/grid showing uploader name, upload timestamp, and a preview thumbnail; allow admin to delete an uploaded image entry.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can see uploaded items with name + timestamp + preview.
Admin can delete an uploaded image; it disappears from the list and is removed from backend storage.
If no images exist, the UI shows a clear empty-state message in English.

requirements.text: Admin Panel → Chat tab: implement a simple admin-manageable chat/messages view consistent with the screenshot’s tab structure, including creating new messages and displaying an ordered message list. Persist messages in the backend so refresh retains history.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can add a message (text) and it appears in the message list.
Messages are persisted in backend storage and load on page refresh.
If no messages exist, show an English empty-state message.
UI is mobile-friendly and visually consistent with the Admin Panel cards/tabs.

requirements.text: Replace the current backend “live events” storage/APIs with a persistent comment-list system backing the screenshot flows: store comment lists, comments, per-comment used status, per-user usage tracking for single/bulk generation, uploaded rating images (blob + metadata), chat messages, and the bulk generator access key. Add query and update methods needed by Customer View and Admin Panel.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes methods to: create/delete/list comment lists; add single/bulk comments to a list; list comments for a list; delete a comment; reset usage for a list; generate single comment for a user; generate bulk comments for a user; get/set/reset bulk access key; upload/list/delete rating images; add/list/delete chat messages.
All data persists across canister upgrades using stable storage patterns appropriate for Motoko.
Single-actor constraint is respected (all logic in backend/main.mo).

requirements.text: Add/adjust migration logic so upgrading from the current deployed canister state (which contains live events state) does not trap, and initializes the new comment-generator/admin-panel state cleanly.
acceptanceCriteria: Canister upgrade succeeds without runtime traps due to state shape mismatch.
After upgrade, the app loads with empty/default comment lists, empty uploads/chat history, and no bulk access key (unless a safe default is required), and the admin can begin populating data.

requirements.text: Match the screenshots’ overall visual style across the rebuilt screens: soft pastel background with subtle geometric/confetti shapes, rounded cards with light borders/shadows, and primary gradient buttons (blue→teal). Apply this theme consistently across Customer View, Upload Section, and Admin Panel.
acceptanceCriteria: All three sections share a consistent background and card styling that closely resembles the screenshots.
Primary actions use a blue→teal gradient button treatment with rounded corners.
Typography and spacing are mobile-first and match the screenshot proportions closely.

requirements.text: Create and use a static background asset similar to the screenshots’ pastel geometric/confetti backdrop, stored under frontend/public/assets/generated, and render it as the page background (not served from the backend).
acceptanceCriteria: A generated background image exists in frontend/public/assets/generated and is referenced by the UI.
The background is visible behind cards and matches the screenshot vibe (pastel, subtle shapes).
No backend endpoints are used to serve the background image.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in backend/main.mo.
Only generate backend/migration.mo when required for state upgrade compatibility; follow the project’s conditional migration policy.

Do not edit frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, and anything under frontend/src/components/ui; compose them instead.
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: Implementing third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity if needed).
Integrating external databases or cloud services.
Implementing payments, social APIs, or LLM integrations.

required: Pastel geometric/confetti background with soft shapes and very light noise texture (admin-bg.dim_1600x900.png)
